modules.description: Verdigris components. Light DOM by design — no shadow roots anywhere. Every element upgrades markup that is already complete and semantic without JS, so the page degrades to correct HTML rather than to nothing. This manifest is hand-authored rather than generated: the system has no build step and no npm dependencies, and adding an analyzer to produce one file would contradict that. The cost is that it can drift, so the checkedAgainst field below records when it was last verified against the source.

declarations.name: VdHero
declarations.description: Page hero. Renders a display line, an optional sub-line, and the generative topolang field behind them. The field is masked to a capped alpha across the text column so the display line stays AAA over the brightest cell the palette can produce; nothing inside the hero may use the muted text value.

attributes.name: thesis
attributes.description: The display line. Required.

attributes.name: sub
attributes.description: Optional sub-line, one register down.

attributes.name: seed
attributes.description: topolang seed. Fixed per page, so every visitor sees the same sequence at the same moment.

attributes.name: field
attributes.description: Set to 'off' to suppress the generative field entirely.

attributes.name: caption
attributes.description: Credit line rendered beneath the field.

declarations.name: VdSystemCard
declarations.description: A work item. Hairline box, no fill. The whole card is clickable via a click handler that guards text selection rather than a stretched overlay link, so the prose stays selectable and middle-click still works on the title itself.

attributes.name: index
attributes.description: Ordinal, e.g. '01'. Rendered in the structure colour.

attributes.name: kicker
attributes.description: Category line above the title.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Card title. Becomes the link text.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Destination. The whole card targets this.

attributes.name: proof
attributes.description: Pipe-separated metric pairs, e.g. 'agents:4|adopted:2026'. Values starting with a digit take the data colour; anything else takes the emphasis text colour, because the data accent is numerals only.

declarations.name: VdNoteCard
declarations.description: A writing item in a ruled list. Hover and focus-within raise a sunken surface plus a 2px inset left bar. The accent is a left bar rather than the horizontal rules because in a ruled list the rules are shared boundaries — accenting your own borders outlines the last item on two sides and every other item on one.

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: ISO-ish publication date, e.g. '2026-08'.

attributes.name: length
attributes.description: Word count, e.g. '2,400 words'.

attributes.name: dek
attributes.description: Standfirst paragraph.

attributes.name: image
attributes.description: Optional thumbnail, drawn at 90px square. Same picture as the article's .vd-article__hero. Omitting it collapses the card to one column and changes nothing else.

attributes.name: image-alt
attributes.description: Alternative text for the thumbnail. Defaults to empty: the title is beside the image, so a screen reader would otherwise announce the piece twice. Pass it only when the picture carries something the title does not.

declarations.name: VdForm
declarations.description: Wraps a native form and replaces the browser's validation bubble with inline messages. Progressive enhancement over the Constraint Validation API: novalidate is set from JS, so with scripting off the browser's own enforcement still applies. Validates on blur, then re-validates on every input once a field has been blurred. On submit, focus moves to the first invalid control - there is no summary block, by decision. If the inner <form> carries an `action`, the element also takes over SUBMISSION: a fetch POST, a pending state, and the outcome announced in .vd-form__result with focus moved to it. `action` is the entire transport seam - a Cloudflare Worker, a hosted form service, anything accepting a POST - and the kit never carries a URL, a key or an address. mailto: is refused deliberately. With no action the element does nothing on submit beyond validating, because a form with no endpoint is a specimen. The body is submitted with FormData, so a third-party challenge widget's hidden input rides along without the kit knowing the vendor exists.

attributes.name: honeypot
attributes.description: Adds an off-screen trap field under this name. Positioned off-screen rather than display:none, which is trivially detected and still reachable by some assistive tech. A non-empty trap renders success and sends nothing - telling a bot it failed is how it learns to pass. The ENDPOINT must reject it too: a bot that ignores script never sees the trap.

attributes.name: min-seconds
attributes.description: Floor below which a submission is treated as a bot. Fails silently, like the honeypot.

attributes.name: data-msg-pending
attributes.description: Wording while the request is in flight.

attributes.name: data-msg-ok
attributes.description: Wording on success. Rendered in --vd-ok with NO underline and never as an anchor: --vd-ok aliases --vd-link, so the underline is the only channel separating a success message from a link.

attributes.name: data-msg-error
attributes.description: Wording on failure. Rendered in --vd-danger.

declarations.name: VdSwatch
declarations.description: Renders a token as a colour chip with its contrast ratio computed live from the resolved custom property. The ratio is never typed in, so the docs cannot drift from the tokens.

attributes.name: token
attributes.description: Custom property to measure, e.g. '--vd-blue-400'.

attributes.name: against
attributes.description: Ground to measure against. Use '--vd-paper-000' for the light set.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Threshold to judge against: 7 for text, 3 for non-text, 0 for decorative and exempt.

attributes.name: note
attributes.description: What the token is for.

declarations.name: VdCode
declarations.description: Code block with a filename header and a copy button.

attributes.name: file
attributes.description: Filename shown in the header.

declarations.name: VdRedact
declarations.description: Turns an IP or confidentiality constraint into a visible design decision rather than an omission. The reason is carried by aria-label and by the title tooltip; print.css prints it inline, because on paper there is no hover to reveal it. Redactions stay redacted when printed.

attributes.name: data-reason
attributes.description: Why this is redacted. Announced, and printed.

declarations.name: VdToc
declarations.description: Builds a table of contents from the headings of another element and tracks the active section. Indexes one document only.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Selector for the element whose headings to index.

declarations.name: VdThemeToggle
declarations.description: Sun/moon glyph button, 44x44. prefers-color-scheme decides by default; an explicit choice overrides it in both directions and persists to localStorage. The CSS does the actual switching on specificity alone, so with JS off the OS preference still works and only the toggle disappears.

events.name: vd-theme
events.description: Fired on window when the resolved theme changes. Anything that cannot read custom properties — currently the topolang canvas — listens for this.

declarations.name: VdNav
declarations.description: Page navigation bar. Sticky at the top with z-index 50; --vd-nav-h names its height so anything that must clear it stays in sync. CSS-only: no JS, no registration. Expects .vd-nav__inner containing .vd-nav__mark, a .vd-nav__list of links, and vd-theme-toggle outside the list.

attributes.name: aria-current
attributes.description: Set on the link for the current page. The active underline is driven by this attribute, not by a class.

declarations.name: VdFooter
declarations.description: Page footer. CSS-only. Expects .vd-footer__inner with link groups and a .vd-footer__sig block. Footer links use .vd-tag rather than bare anchors — a standalone link is not exempt from 2.5.8 and a bare one measures 52x18.

declarations.name: VdQuote
declarations.description: Pull-quote: your own line, lifted out. Takes the editorial teal left rule. Distinct from a bare <blockquote>, which is someone else's words and is deliberately quieter. Contains a <blockquote> and an optional <figcaption> for attribution. CSS-only.

declarations.name: VdFigure
declarations.description: A captioned image. Adds a caption and vertical rhythm — it does NOT add a frame, and neither does a bare image. The difference between the two is the caption. Both are max-width constrained; the bare-image rule is a 1.4.10 fix rather than a style. Contains an or

attributes.name: expandable
attributes.description: Opt in to click-to-expand. Wraps the image in a button and opens it uncropped, with its caption, in one shared modal dialog. Opt-in rather than default because the article slots crop and only some figures benefit, and because making every figure a control would add a tab stop to every published page at once. Ignored when the image is already inside a link.

declarations.name: VdMeta
declarations.description: Metadata strip: a flex row of values separated by hairline rules, in the mono face. CSS-only. Below 860px it becomes a single-column list with bottom borders rather than wrapping, because wrapping leaves a rule hanging in space.

checkedAgainst.note: Hand-authored, so it can drift. 14 vd-* tags exist: 9 registered custom elements, 5 CSS-only styling hooks with no JS (customElement:false). To re-verify, check BOTH sources and re-stamp this block. (1) The defs array at the bottom of verdigris.js must match the 9 entries marked customElement:true. (2) Every vd-* used as an ELEMENT selector in verdigris.css must appear here — note that vd-cite, vd-diagram, vd-note, vd-ol and vd-tag look like tags in a grep but are comment headers and CSS counter names, and vd-form, vd-swatch and vd-toc are registered elements styled only through classes. Checking the defs array alone reports a false exact match and misses all 5 CSS-only hooks.
